feeds.title: Patheos
feeds.description: Hi! I'm John Beckett. I grew up in Tennessee with the woods right outside my back door. Wandering through them gave me a sense of connection to Nature and to a certain Forest God. I'm a Druid graduate of the Order of Bards, Ovates and Druids, and a member of Ár nDraíocht Féin. I've been writing, speaking, teaching, and leading public rituals since 2003.

feeds.title: The Druids Garden Blog
feeds.description: Spiritual Journeys in Tending the Land, Permaculture, Wildcrafting, and Regenerative Living. This group serves to be a space of conversation and collaboration about the role that sustainability, permaculture design, organic gardening, wildcrafting, simple living, and other earth-based living practices have within Druidry today.

feeds.title: Druid Life
feeds.description: I'm Nimue Brown. Druid Life is all about Pagan reflections from a Druid author - life, community, inspiration, health, hope, and radical change. Aside from this blog, I write all manner of things, I have a lot of published books to my name, and will try pretty much anything if it looks interesting.

feeds.title: Down the Forest Path
feeds.description: Joanna van der Hoeven here! I am a Druid and a Witch. I honor the land upon which I live, and live in accordance with the land, honoring the seasons, the ancestors, the spirits of the hearth, and home. Down the Forest Path is a Journey Through Nature, it's Magic and Mystery.

feeds.title: Ecosophia
feeds.description: The official blog of John Michael Greer discusses the overlaps between ecology, spirituality, and the future of industrial society. John Michael Greer is a widely read author, blogger, and astrologer whose work focuses on the overlaps between ecology, spirituality, and the future of industrial society.

feeds.title: Ditzy Druid
feeds.description: M. A. Phillips is a writer and fabric artist in Northern NY. She lives with her husband, daughter, and three lazy cats. She fell in love with writing and sewing at a young age thanks to her encouraging, creative family. Over the years, she's made various plushies and fabric art dolls who have found homes on bookshelves and altars around the United States.

feeds.title: Greywolf's Lair
feeds.description: Greywolf's Lair is your source to read articles on Shamanism, Art, Death, Healing, History, Mortality, Music, Rituals, and more.

feeds.title: Druid Journal
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jeff Lilly. I am a druid, linguist, and author. I write about meditation, relationship with Spirit, soulful fulfillment in scholarship and art, reconnecting the ancient with the modern, creating beauty, and healing the world.

feeds.title: Contemplative Inquiry Blog
feeds.description: I am James Nichol and I live in the city of Gloucester, England, having just moved there from Stroud in the same county. My contemplative inquiry began in 2012, grounded in modern Druidry. In this blog, I include personal sharing, photographs, discursive writing, poetry, and book reviews.

feeds.title: Alison Leigh Lilly
feeds.description: Alison Leigh Lilly grew up a shy Irish Catholic hippie girl, exploring the woods and fields surrounding her childhood home. She now resides in the lovely, rain-drizzled cityscape of Seattle, where she lives with her husband, her black cat, and pet frog. She devotes her time to cultivating a spiritual life founded on peace, poesis, and attentive engagement with the inner and outer landscapes of wildness, wilderness, and nature. She explores these themes through writing and visual art.

feeds.title: The Weekly Druid
feeds.description: The Weekly Druid brings you the commentary from the grove. Read articles on Alpine Customs and Lore, Druid Contemplation, Resources, Magic, and Pagan Ceremonies.

feeds.title: The Druid's Well
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Catriona McDonald. Being a good ol' American Mutt, a number of different influences currently inform my spiritual practices - probably more of the subconscious than I'd like to admit. Druidry provides my spatial and temporal framework as well as my connections to the Gods and Spirits, and Witchcraft is the technology that pulls everything together.

feeds.title: The Catbox
feeds.description: Musings on modern Druidry in the UK. I'm Cat Treadwell, a Druid Priest living in Derbyshire, England with my partner and animal family. I'm a professional ritual celebrant and multifaith worker, traveling throughout the East Midlands and beyond. My first book, 'A Druid's Tale' was published in 2012, with the second, 'Facing the Darkness', in October 2013

feeds.title: Druid Monastic
feeds.description: Druid Monastic is your source to read about the musings of a contemplative monastic Druid.

feeds.title: Rhyd Wildermuth Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm a druid. A gay punk gardener gym bro. An occasional nomad. A theorist and a poet. A publisher and editor. Sometimes an anarchist, sometimes a Marxist. I'm devoted to Brythonic and Gallic gods and some local land spirits and ancestors. I'm all of those things, and also other things. I'm mostly on the side of good.

feeds.title: Esoteric Moment
feeds.description: Hey there! I'm Danni Lang. I am passionately curious about how an earth-centered spirituality and lifestyle can bring peace and wisdom to my life. Esoteric Moment is the online, sacred grove where I can share the wisdom found in Druidry, Pagan Books, and Permaculture with others who share this passion.
